# attested in source

The bibliographic or documentary source in which the attested form was observed. NON-FUNCTIONAL: an attestation may be supported by multiple sources, and competing source attributions coexist (Principle 9). Targets a CreativeWork (the retired Source Kind was greenfield-refactored in #211).
